messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "5.6 mg (2 sublingual tablets)"
set: ["5.6 mg (2 sublingual tablets)", "5.6 mg once daily", "200 mg (sustained-release tablets)", "sublingual tablet", "Tonmya sublingual tablets", "Tonmya sublingual tablets (fibromyalgia)", "150 mg orally twice a day (sustained-release tablets)", "300 mg orally once a day (extended-release tablets)", "2.8 mg (1 sublingual tablet) once daily at bedtime", "450 mg/day (extended-release tablets)", "400 mg/day (sustained-release tablets)", "2.8 mg once daily at bedtime for 14 days, then 5.6 mg once daily at bedtime", "150 mg orally once a day in the morning (extended-release tablets)", "150 mg orally once a day in the morning (sustained-release tablets)", "Tonmya sublingual tablets taken once a day", "increase to 150 mg orally twice a day after 3 days (sustained-release tablets)"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
